Second, session transcripts must be deleted after exactly 30 days — the draft plan currently retains them for 90 days. I haven't opened the compliance ticket yet because legal was still reviewing the wording, but these requirements need to be reflected in the finalized launch plan before we proceed.

I have not yet filed the client-library ticket, but this needs to be reflected in the finalized launch plan before we proceed.
